settings.title: Plug in
settings.text: Connect any USB power bank to the cable in the inner pocket. A 10,000 mAh bank is a good match.

settings.title: Press the button
settings.text: Turn the heat on and switch between three levels with the button on the chest.

settings.title: Head out
settings.text: Carbon-fibre panels warm your core. The maker rates it at up to 8–12 hours on a full 10,000 mAh charge, depending on heat level.

settings.title: Essential
settings.text: Lightest heat coverage. Good for mild days, commutes and layering under a shell.

settings.title: Everyday
settings.text: More panels across the body for colder walks, dog walks and errands.

settings.title: Deep cold
settings.text: Wide heat coverage for long stretches outside in deep cold.

settings.title: Maximum
settings.text: The most heating zones we offer, for the coldest days of the year.

settings.title: 30-Day Promise
settings.text: Not right for you? Full refund within 30 days.

settings.title: Real Support
settings.text: Real answers within 2 business days, usually the same day.

settings.question: Is a power bank included?
settings.answer: No. The jacket works with any USB power bank. A 10,000 mAh bank is a good size: it fits the inner pocket and gives the longest run time.

settings.question: What size should I order?
settings.answer: These jackets run 1–2 sizes small. Check the size guide above, and if you're between sizes or want to wear a sweater underneath, size up.

settings.question: Can I wash it?
settings.answer: Yes. Unplug and remove the power bank first, then wash on a gentle cycle and let it air dry.

settings.question: What do Zone 2, 4, 8 and 9 mean?
settings.answer: The number is how many heating zones the jacket has. More zones spread heat over more of your body.

settings.question: How much is shipping?
settings.answer: Shipping is free on every order. Delivery times by region are in our shipping policy. Import duties and taxes for your country are either included in the price or shown at checkout, depending on where you live.

settings.question: What if it doesn't fit?
settings.answer: You have 30 days to ask for a full refund. See our refund policy.
